title: Algorithm analysis of John Ward's Mars anomalies

tellings.quote:
I apply some algorithms
to evaluate that evaluate the likelihood
that they can be naturally formed
fractal and texture-based algorithms.

plain: Odd shapes spotted on the surface of Mars by a man named John Ward, who combed through orbital photos for anomalies, have been put through computer tests to see whether nature could have made them. Maaneli Derakhshani, a researcher who did the analysis himself, tells Michels he applied "fractal and texture-based algorithms" to images from NASA's Mars Global Surveyor orbiter and the HiRISE high-resolution Mars camera to judge how likely the features are to be natural. If they scored as unlikely to be natural, it would point to something built on Mars.
